name: Open WebUI + Ollama
author: barticekk@barticekk.eu
description:
Self-hosted AI chat. Open WebUI provides the ChatGPT-like interface with user accounts, Ollama runs
local models next to it inside the same server and is only reachable from inside the container.
Can also connect to an external Ollama or OpenAI-compatible API instead.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Open WebUI + Ollama install script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Only Ollama is fetched here. Open WebUI is pip-installed on the first start inside the runtime
# image, where the server's own RAM and disk apply and the progress shows in the console.
set -eo pipefail
trap 'echo "Install failed at line ${LINENO}: ${BASH_COMMAND}"; echo "Check free disk space and network access to ollama.com and github.com."' ERR

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates zstd

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) ARCH=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) ARCH=arm64 ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported architecture $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p data logs models

if [ "${BUNDLED_OLLAMA}" == "1" ]; then
    echo "Installing Ollama"
    EXCLUDES=()
    if [ "${OLLAMA_GPU_LIBS}" != "1" ]; then
        # containers on a panel node have no GPU, skip about 2.3 GB of CUDA and Vulkan runners
        EXCLUDES=(--exclude='lib/ollama/cuda_*' --exclude='lib/ollama/rocm*' --exclude='lib/ollama/vulkan')
    fi
    rm -rf ollama
    mkdir -p ollama
    curl -fsSL "https://ollama.com/download/ollama-linux-${ARCH}.tar.zst" | tar -I zstd -x -C ollama "${EXCLUDES[@]}"
    ./ollama/bin/ollama --version 2>/dev/null || true
fi

# a reinstall forces Open WebUI to be installed again on the next start
rm -f venv/.installed-version

cat > start.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
cd /home/container

VENV=/home/container/venv
WANT=${WEBUI_VERSION:-latest}

install_webui() {
    echo "-----------------------------------------"
    echo "Installing Open WebUI (${WANT}). The first start takes 5-15 minutes."
    echo "-----------------------------------------"
    # /tmp is a small tmpfs on panel nodes and the torch wheel alone is over 200 MB
    export TMPDIR=/home/container/.pip-tmp
    mkdir -p "${TMPDIR}"
    # a venv left over from an older version of this egg may point at /mnt/server
    if [ -d "${VENV}" ] && ! head -n1 "${VENV}/bin/pip" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "^#!${VENV}/bin/python"; then
        echo "Removing an unusable virtualenv"
        rm -rf "${VENV}"
    fi
    if [ ! -x "${VENV}/bin/python" ]; then
        python3 -m venv "${VENV}" || return 1
    fi
    "${VENV}/bin/pip" install --no-cache-dir --progress-bar off --upgrade pip || return 1
    if [ "$(uname -m)" == "x86_64" ]; then
        # CPU wheels of torch; the default ones pull several GB of CUDA libraries
        "${VENV}/bin/pip" install --no-cache-dir --progress-bar off torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu || return 1
    fi
    if [ "${WANT}" == "latest" ]; then
        "${VENV}/bin/pip" install --no-cache-dir --progress-bar off --upgrade open-webui || return 1
    else
        "${VENV}/bin/pip" install --no-cache-dir --progress-bar off "open-webui==${WANT}" || return 1
    fi
    rm -rf "${TMPDIR}"
    echo "${WANT}" > "${VENV}/.installed-version"
    echo "Open WebUI $("${VENV}/bin/pip" show open-webui | awk '/^Version/ {print $2}') installed"
}

if [ ! -x "${VENV}/bin/open-webui" ] || [ "$(cat "${VENV}/.installed-version" 2>/dev/null)" != "${WANT}" ]; then
    if ! install_webui; then
        echo "Installing Open WebUI failed, see the pip output above."
        echo "Usual causes: not enough disk space (needs about 4 GiB free) or no access to pypi.org / download.pytorch.org."
        exit 1
    fi
fi

export DATA_DIR=/home/container/data
export HF_HOME=/home/container/data/cache/huggingface
export WEBUI_URL="${WEBUI_URL}"
export ENABLE_SIGNUP="${ENABLE_SIGNUP}"
export SCARF_NO_ANALYTICS=true DO_NOT_TRACK=true ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY=false

if [ "${BUNDLED_OLLAMA}" == "1" ] && [ -x ollama/bin/ollama ]; then
    export OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11434
    export OLLAMA_MODELS=/home/container/models
    export OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434
    echo "Starting Ollama (log: logs/ollama.log)"
    ./ollama/bin/ollama serve >> logs/ollama.log 2>&1 &
    for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
        curl -fs http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version > /dev/null && break
        sleep 1
    done
    if [ -n "${OLLAMA_PULL_MODELS}" ]; then
        (
            for model in ${OLLAMA_PULL_MODELS//,/ }; do
                echo "Pulling model ${model} in the background"
                for attempt in 1 2 3; do
                    if ./ollama/bin/ollama pull "${model}" >> logs/ollama.log 2>&1; then
                        echo "Model ${model} ready"
                        break
                    fi
                    [ "${attempt}" == "3" ] && echo "Pulling ${model} failed, see logs/ollama.log"
                    sleep 10
                done
            done
        ) &
    fi
elif [ "${BUNDLED_OLLAMA}" == "1" ]; then
    echo "Bundled Ollama is on but ollama/ is missing. Reinstall the server to download it."
    export ENABLE_OLLAMA_API=false
elif [ -n "${OLLAMA_URL}" ]; then
    export OLLAMA_BASE_URL="${OLLAMA_URL}"
else
    export ENABLE_OLLAMA_API=false
fi

if [ -n "${WEBUI_URL}" ]; then
    export CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN="${WEBUI_URL}"
fi

# uvicorn's own startup lines are swallowed by Open WebUI's logging, so announce readiness here
(
    until curl -fs "http://127.0.0.1:${SERVER_PORT}/health" > /dev/null; do
        sleep 3
    done
    echo "Open WebUI is ready on port ${SERVER_PORT}"
) &

exec "${VENV}/bin/open-webui" serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port "${SERVER_PORT}"
EOF
chmod 755 start.sh

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Install finished. Open WebUI itself is installed on the first start (watch the console)."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Address users open, e.g. https://ai.example.com. Used for links and OAuth.

variables.name: Allow Signups
variables.description: The first account becomes admin. Later signups wait for admin approval; set false to close registration completely.

variables.name: Bundled Ollama
variables.description: Run Ollama inside this server (only reachable from the container). Turn off to use an external Ollama URL. Reinstall after changing.

variables.name: Models To Pull
variables.description: Comma separated Ollama models downloaded on start if missing, e.g. llama3.2:3b,qwen2.5:1.5b. Needs RAM roughly equal to the model size.

variables.name: External Ollama URL
variables.description: Used when Bundled Ollama is off, e.g. http://10.0.0.5:11434

variables.name: Ollama GPU Libraries
variables.description: Also install the CUDA/Vulkan runners (about 2.3 GB). Only useful when the node passes a GPU into containers.

variables.name: Open WebUI Version
variables.description: latest or a release such as 0.12.5. Changing it reinstalls Open WebUI on the next start; Reinstall also updates latest. data/ and models/ are kept.
